claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a Blue Gate UPS.
The witness cannot see the internal battery or its manufacture date.
Battery duration depends on load and requires hours of observation.
The witness did not report on the condition of the warranty seals or screw holes.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the technical specification sticker on the back or side.
A video showing the UPS powering a load (like a lamp) while the input plug is disconnected.
A photo of the rear panel showing all power outlets.
risks.if_unproven: as having faulty or broken sockets

proof_requests: Photo of the sticker on the back or side showing the model number and VA rating.
Photo of the rear panel to see the number and type of sockets.
Video of the unit powered on and supporting a device without being plugged into the wall.
response.reason: The capacity (VA rating) is missing from the report, which is the primary factor for pricing a UPS. The battery health claim is also highly optimistic and needs verification.
